$comment: The grammar leg's skip register: parse-kind cases whose rejection lives outside the grammar layer's reach. EMPTY as of suite 3.10.0 — the per-construct typed surface in grammar/primmel.parg (the dispatch, the required-value badness predicates, the closed facet vocabularies, the scoped sub-block dispatch with sub-keyword-excluded bares) carried the kernel's per-construct parse discipline for every corpus case then in the suite. The register only shrinks and may only be repopulated with a reason a future case proves; the leg errors on a stale entry (a case that agrees without the skip), on an entry naming a case that no longer exists, and on a disagreement whose case is not registered.

skips.reason: the retired step-level executor facet is refused by the kernel's per-construct step-body parse discipline (a closed facet vocabulary of the step body); the PG grammar's process block is the open item stream and cannot express the scoped step dispatch yet — the grammar-side enforcement (a scoped does-block step rule with a badness predicate) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/05) DESIGN (2026-11-01, scoped): the mechanism is in-file — scoped sub-block rules with badness predicates on the carrier_kv routing idiom (a `step_kv`-style rule routes the sub-block through its own `block_X` with `bad_X` naming the retired facet). The execution gate is the BAKE: the checked-in artifact is compiled externally (the rs-side compiler; CI never bakes), so editing primmel.parg without a rebake silently diverges the artifact — the bake toolchain run is the step this design awaits. BAKE-GATE SHARPENED (2026-11-02): the vendored wasm cannot reproduce the checked-in artifact in EITHER generation (the stale d9d9206 and the fresh 0629644 both emit a different envelope — key order + a checksum field) — the artifact's producer is an OLDER generation of the rs compiler. Execution therefore needs a parsanol-rs archaeology pass (find the producer commit) or an owner-blessed artifact-lineage migration; both are parsanol owner decisions, not primmel toolchain runs. The primmel.parg edit was reverted unmerged — the source never diverges from its artifact. EXECUTED PROBE (2026-11-02, two days of evidence): the five non-wf-01 refusals are GRAMMAR-EXPRESSIBLE — the working rules are proven (the scoped field body for calculation_bindings; the construct-level badness predicates `("pass_fail" !bare_next)`, `("validate_measurement" !bare_next)`, `("acceptance_criteria" !bare_next)`, `("statement" gap &("\""))`; the head-exclusion fallbacks must be TERMINAL — a trailing generic alternative swallows the routed refusal). The wf-01 does→action chain ENGAGES (the reject-all probe) but the badness inside the routed sub-block does not fire — a parsanol wasm compile question. AND THE MIGRATION COST IS NOW NAMED: baking with ANY available wasm generation migrates the envelope (the checked-in artifact's producer is an older rs generation), and the migrated envelope BREAKS checker2 parity at CHK-01/CHK-04's negatives and the shape-front-end's file-by-file agreement (the capture-generation difference). The landing is a LINEAGE WAVE: the artifact migration + checker2's reader re-tuning, with the parsanol owner in the loop (the capture-mode reversal history is theirs). The probe's grammar edits were reverted — the source never diverges from its artifact.
